title: equisetum arvense subsp. agreste
intro: Equisetum arvense subsp. agreste, commonly known as Field Horsetail, is a type of perennial plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving urinary tract health. The therapeutic actions of Field Horsetail include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its ability to remove excess fluids and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of Field Horsetail include flavonoids, saponins, and caffeic acid, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
